Question 3
?

A gas station pump dispenses gas into an empty gas tank at a rate of 116t liters per second. Write an expression for A(t), the total volume of gas in the tank at time t, where t is the time measured in second.

a
A(t)=56t+11t212
b
A(t)=5+11t212
c
A(t)=5+56t
d
A(t)=11t212
e
A(t)=5+56t+11t212
